title: Room model
description: Published once per room day, retained, by the room model process to MQTT topic room/<room>/model. The three rates of dC/dt = a·N − (b0 + b1·d)·(C − Cout), fitted from stored history; N is the head count, d the damper level (0–1), Cout the outdoor CO2 level.

room_id.description: Room identifier, matching BuildSim's room key.

date.description: The local calendar date the model was fitted on (YYYY-MM-DD).

a.description: CO2 rise per person, in ppm per minute.

b0.description: Share of the gap to outdoor CO2 cleared per minute with the damper closed.

b1.description: Share of the gap cleared per minute added by each unit of damper opening.
